mission.heading: We build bridges to equal opportunity and social participation.
mission.intro: <name>EFI - Engagement für Integration e.V.</name> is a non-profit association and a recognised migrant-led organisation. Our central aim is the lasting, all-round support of migrants and refugees on their path to integration — entirely regardless of origin, language or religious belief.
mission.reach: From our permanent base in Castrop-Rauxel, across the Dortmund area and out to our dialogue network in Berlin, we support people through practical education, one-to-one help with official procedures, and lively meeting places where mutual understanding can grow.
mission.quote: “Integration is not a one-way street. It is an encounter between equals.”
mission.yearsLabel: years building bridges in North Rhine-Westphalia
mission.cta: Read more about our board and statutes

areas.badge: The four pillars of our work
areas.heading: Support, advice, encounter and education.
areas.intro: Our all-round approach to social participation and independence in the Ruhr region.

begleitung.title: Support
begleitung.description: Language mediation & everyday orientation: trained volunteers who help overcome language barriers at public offices, doctors' appointments, nurseries and schools.

beratung.title: Advice
beratung.description: General social advice: accessible help with official applications (citizens' office, immigration office, Jobcenter online), initial guidance and referral to specialist services.

begegnung.title: Encounter
begegnung.description: Dance, women's café & dialogue: open and protected spaces at the Begegnungszentrum Merklinde to meet as equals, get to know one another and take down prejudice.

bildung.title: Education
bildung.description: Tutoring, language café & workshops: free homework support for pupils, everyday language practice and hands-on seminars in basic digital skills.

join.heading: Would you like to support our organisation?
join.text: Help us become better known. Share what we offer with friends, families and neighbours — or get involved with EFI e.V. yourself.

projects.heading: Follow all our projects and activities.
projects.intro: A look at our current initiatives, language workshops and meeting places across the region.
projects.cta: Ask about all current events & courses

tandem.imageAlt: Tandem statt Barriere – inclusive cycling in Castrop-Rauxel
tandem.title: Tandem statt Barriere
tandem.description: Getting mobile together: cycling and road safety training for people with and without disabilities, at any age. Bicycles and guidance provided.

digitalWomen.title: Everyday digital orientation
digitalWomen.description: For refugee and migrant women: booking online appointments at the citizens' office or Jobcenter, scanning documents, using nursery apps and online mailboxes independently.

tutoring.title: Free tutoring
tutoring.description: Qualified support in German, French, mathematics and English for children of all ages in Castrop-Rauxel and Dortmund.

womensCafe.imageAlt: Women's café at the Begegnungszentrum Merklinde
womensCafe.title: Women's café Castrop-Rauxel
womensCafe.description: A protected space to meet people, practise German, share experiences and gather strength over coffee and good conversation.

locations.heading: Rooted in the Ruhr region — connected all the way to Berlin.
locations.intro: With our meeting centre in Castrop-Rauxel, our project hub in Dortmund and our dialogue presence in the federal capital, we are close to people locally and connected nationally.
